name: chatgpt-prompts
description: Comprehensive collection of curated ChatGPT prompts from the awesome-chatgpt-prompts repository (143k+ stars). Use when Codex needs prompt templates for role-playing, specialized tasks, or specific scenarios. Includes prompts for various roles (developer, translator, interviewer, terminal, etc.), creative tasks (storyteller, poet, rapper), professional roles (doctor, lawyer, recruiter), and utilities (SQL terminal, Excel, domain generator).
